messages:
Nina (Recruiter): Quick heads-up: Samir accepted offer with start 2026-05-03. He flagged that his spouse Aisha is on an H-4 EAD which expires 2026-05-01 and renewal is pending. They asked if spouse can be added to benefits as a dependent day 1 if renewal not back yet.
Priya - People Ops: Welcome! Short answer: spouse enrollment requires proof of relationship (marriage cert) and the employee's lawful status; spouses work auth isn't required for dependent enrollment but benefits carrier may require ID. We need marriage certificate + SSN (if available) or passport. If spouse is outside US during renewal, carrier rules differ.
Hector (Payroll): For benefits we need enrollment completed in ADP before benefits cutoff. If spouse documentation is incomplete at activation we can queue enrollment but carrier may deny retro coverage. We can prepare forms and hold them pending docs.
Samir (New Hire): Thanks. Aisha is currently in the US but her EAD was filed 4/10 (biometrics done 4/22). I can upload the marriage certificate now. She doesn't have SSN yet (applied in 2021 but card misplaced), will apply for replacement if needed.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Samir: marriage_certificate_scan.pdf (HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: Good. Please upload passport scan and any USCIS receipts for Aisha's EAD. We'll send the benefits packet now and note "pending dependent docs". If the EAD renewal is still outstanding at benefits effective date, carrier may still accept dependent based on marriage cert and passport; varies by carrier.
Aisha (Spouse): Hi everyone  I uploaded the I-797C receipt and passport scan to the portal. Im applying for a replacement SSN card but that can take a few weeks.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Aisha: i797c_aisha.pdf, passport_aisha.pdf (HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Hector (Payroll): Thanks Aisha. We'll mark enrollment as pending. Payroll note: if dependent docs come in after payroll cutoff we can still request retroactive coverage but it's at carrier discretion. Also note: if we reimburse any immigration fees for spouse, Legal must approve and Finance will tax-evaluate.
Legal-Team: Reminder: Redwood's policy covers limited spouse immigration expense only in defined cases (e.g., relocating executives) and typically not routine EAD renewals. We can guide on tax treatment and draft any necessary acknowledgments. If employee requests reimbursement, we need pre-approval.
Priya - People Ops: Ok - two separate threads here: benefits onboarding for spouse, and reimbursement/tax treatment if they ask us to pay premium processing or replacement SSN expedited fees. For benefits: we'll prepare enrollment packet and submit to carrier with pending docs; Samir/Aisha please keep tracking numbers and notify Benefits team when SSN is issued.
Samir (New Hire): Understood. If Aisha needs to travel for biometrics or appointment we prefer to schedule around onboarding. Any travel risks to be aware of?
Legal-Team: If spouse travels while EAD renewal is pending, re-entry risks depend on admitted status. For H-4 dependents with a valid visa stamp, travel is usually lower risk. If no valid visa, traveling outside US could complicate return. Recommend consulting immigration counsel. We'll provide boilerplate travel advisory for them to sign if travel unavoidable.
Priya - People Ops: Also note: If Aisha obtains SSN after benefits cutoff but before the carriers retro window (usually 30 days), we often can backdate coverage. We'll track key dates. Hector, please set payroll/benefits reminders.
Hector (Payroll): Done. I set a reminder: "Check Aisha dependent docs" for 2026-05-02 09:00. Also added a note to Samir's new hire file about pending dependent enrollment.
people-ops-bot: Reminder created: "Check Aisha dependent docs" on 2026-05-02 09:00
Priya - People Ops: Action items:
- Samir/Aisha: upload SSN replacement receipt when available and keep USPS/tracking.
- Nina: confirm carrier contact for dependent acceptance rules and share in thread.
- Hector: hold benefits enrollment but prepare packet; flag retro window.
- Legal-Team: draft travel advisory and reimbursement policy summary if requested.
Nina (Recruiter): I'll ping Benefits carrier now and update.
Aisha (Spouse): Thanks all  uploaded SSN replacement receipt when I submitted the request. Will update when card arrives.
Priya - People Ops: Great. We'll proceed with pending enrollment and keep Samir updated. If reimbursement is requested, we need pre-approval. Closing for now  will post any carrier replies here. :thumbsup:
